dataInfo.sql: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_NUMBER, O.ORDER_DATE, O.STATUS, O.VAT_RATE, C.CODE AS CUSTOMER_CODE, C.COMPANY_NAME, C.CONTACT_NAME, C.ADDRESS, C.POSTAL_CODE, C.CITY, C.COUNTRY, E.FIRST_NAME, E.LAST_NAME, L.LINE_NO, P.SKU, P.NAME AS PRODUCT, P.UNIT, L.QUANTITY, L.UNIT_PRICE, L.DISCOUNT FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMERS C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN EMPLOYEES E ON E.EMPLOYEE_ID = O.EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN ORDER_LINES L ON L.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID BETWEEN :FIRST_ORDER AND :LAST_ORDER ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID, L.LINE_NO
